# UITextComponent

*Client* · extends [`UIComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIComponent)

Multi-line text of a script UI that wraps to the component width.

## Methods

### text {#text}

::: member

Replaces the text.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | new text; `\n` starts a new line |

**Returns** [`UITextComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UITextComponent) — this text

:::

### lineHeight {#lineheight}

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lineHeight` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | line height in pixels |

**Returns** [`UITextComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UITextComponent) — this text

:::

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | color as `0xRRGGBB` or `0xAARRGGBB` |
| `shadow` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | whether the text has a shadow |

**Returns** [`UITextComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UITextComponent) — this text
